  else
    bad "R5 it must NOT print 'all checks OK' when a check was SKIPPED" "printed: $S_OUT"
  fi
  if [[ "$S_OUT" == *"SKIP"* ]]; then
    ok "R6 ...and it NAMES the skip, so a check that stopped checking is not silent"
  else
    bad "R6 it must NAME the skip" "printed: $S_OUT"
  fi
  S_CLEAN_OUT=$(drive_summary_out 0 0)
  if [[ "$S_CLEAN_OUT" == *"all checks OK"* ]]; then
    ok "R7 CONTROL with SKIPS=0 it still prints 'all checks OK', so R5 is not an unconditional gag"
  else
    bad "R7 CONTROL SKIPS=0 must still print 'all checks OK'" "printed: $S_CLEAN_OUT"
  fi
fi

# ---- deploy-all.sh must count a SKIP separately and must not fail the deploy for it ----
# 🔴 R8 USED TO BE `grep -q smoke_skip`, AND A TAMPER CAUGHT IT. Replacing the skip CALL with a
# `smoke_test ... "0 failed" "0 failed"` — the exact regression this cell exists to stop, which puts
# a check that did not run back into the PASS count — left the `smoke_skip()` DEFINITION in the file,
# so the grep still matched and the suite stayed GREEN. A presence-grep cannot see whether the path
# is wired. So deploy-all.sh's own call site is now extracted and EXECUTED, like deploy.sh's.
ALL_MARKER='# 1b. KS-1054 / N-1332-5 — startup migrations.'
ALL_HITS=$(grep -cF "$ALL_MARKER" "$ALL" || true)
if [[ "$ALL_HITS" != "1" ]]; then
  bad "R8a deploy-all.sh's call site is locatable by marker" "expected 1 occurrence, found $ALL_HITS"
else
  ok "R8a deploy-all.sh's call site is locatable by marker (1 occurrence, extraction unambiguous)"
fi
ALL_BLOCK=$(awk -v m="$ALL_MARKER" 'index($0,m){f=1} f{print} f&&/^esac$/{exit}' "$ALL")

drive_all_callsite() { # $1 = stub predicate rc -> prints "PASS=<n> FAIL=<n> SKIP=<n>"
  local stubrc="$1" dir
  dir="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ks1054_allsite.XXXXXX")"
  printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\nexit %s\n' "$stubrc" > "$dir/check-startup-migrations.sh"
  chmod +x "$dir/check-startup-migrations.sh"
  {
    # The REAL counter semantics, copied from deploy-all.sh's own helpers: a pass increments PASS,
    # a mismatch increments FAIL, a skip increments SKIP. Stubbing them is what lets the block's
    # OWN dispatch decide which one moves.
    printf 'PASS=0; FAIL=0; SKIP=0\n'
    printf 'smoke_test() { if [ "$3" = "$2" ]; then PASS=$((PASS+1)); else FAIL=$((FAIL+1)); fi; }\n'
    printf 'smoke_skip() { SKIP=$((SKIP+1)); }\n'
    printf 'API=http://127.0.0.1:1\nHEALTH_BODY=\x27{"status":"healthy"}\x27\n'
    printf 'curl() { printf %%s "$HEALTH_BODY"; }\n'
    printf '%s\n' "$ALL_BLOCK"
    printf 'printf "PASS=%%s FAIL=%%s SKIP=%%s\\n" "$PASS" "$FAIL" "$SKIP"\n'
  } > "$dir/drive.sh"
  ( cd "$dir" && bash ./drive.sh 2>/dev/null < /dev/null | tail -1 )
  rm -rf "$dir"
}

if [[ -z "$ALL_BLOCK" ]]; then
  bad "R8 rc 2 increments SKIP and neither PASS nor FAIL" "the deploy-all call-site block extracted EMPTY"
else
  A_SKIP=$(drive_all_callsite 2)
  if [[ "$A_SKIP" == "PASS=0 FAIL=0 SKIP=1" ]]; then
    ok "R8 rc 2 increments SKIP and NEITHER PASS nor FAIL, so it is not counted as a passing check"
  else
    bad "R8 rc 2 increments SKIP and neither PASS nor FAIL" "got '$A_SKIP', want 'PASS=0 FAIL=0 SKIP=1'"
  fi
  A_PASS=$(drive_all_callsite 0)
  if [[ "$A_PASS" == "PASS=1 FAIL=0 SKIP=0" ]]; then
    ok "R8b CONTROL rc 0 still increments PASS, so R8 is not an unconditional skip"
  else
    bad "R8b CONTROL rc 0 still increments PASS" "got '$A_PASS', want 'PASS=1 FAIL=0 SKIP=0'"
  fi
  A_FAIL=$(drive_all_callsite 1)
  if [[ "$A_FAIL" == "PASS=0 FAIL=1 SKIP=0" ]]; then
    ok "R8c CONTROL rc 1 still increments FAIL, so the third state did not weaken the real check"
  else
    bad "R8c CONTROL rc 1 still increments FAIL" "got '$A_FAIL', want 'PASS=0 FAIL=1 SKIP=0'"
  fi
fi
# R9 is STRUCTURAL and is labelled as such: it reads the results LINE, which prints no counter this
# harness can drive without running the whole smoke phase against a live stack.
if grep -q 'SMOKE TEST RESULTS: $PASS passed, $FAIL failed, $SKIP skipped' "$ALL"; then
  ok "R9 (structural) the SMOKE TEST RESULTS line reports the skip count beside pass and fail"
else
  bad "R9 (structural) the results line reports the skip count" "the results line does not carry \$SKIP"
fi
# The exit rule must stay keyed on FAIL alone, or a SKIP would fail the deploy.
if grep -qE '^\s*if \[\[ \$FAIL -gt 0 \]\]; then' "$ALL"; then
  ok "R10 deploy-all.sh still exits non-zero on FAIL alone, so a SKIP never fails the deploy"
else
  bad "R10 deploy-all.sh exits on FAIL alone" "the exit condition changed shape; a SKIP may now fail the deploy"
fi

echo
echo "ks1054 deploy startupMigrations: $pass passed, $fail failed"
[[ "$fail" -eq 0 ]] || exit 1
